questions.topic: The span a passing tone bridges

stimulus.body: A short reference note on the span a passing tone bridges is set for a close-reading task. It states: A diatonic passing tone fills a whole-step gap. A marginal reminder adds: whole step. Four statements are then offered, and only one of them follows from what the note actually says.

questions.stem: The rule to carry into this item is “State passing tone interval / Whole step. / The span a passing tone bridges”. Which option applies it?

options.text: Fifth between two chord tones
Half step between two chord tones
Third between two chord tones
Whole step between two chord tones

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: a diatonic passing tone fills a whole-step gap. On that basis "Whole step between two chord tones" is the supported choice. Option A ("Fifth between two chord tones") fails because it overstates the bridge; Option B ("Half step between two chord tones") fails because it confuses with chromatic passing tone; Option C ("Third between two chord tones") fails because it overstates the bridge.
